summary: This Form 8-K filed by All In FutureTech Alliance, Inc. reports stockholder approval of a reverse stock split proposal and the board's subsequent implementation at a 1-for-6 ratio. The filing covers items 5.07 and 8.01, disclosing voting results (21,232,142 for, 134,949 against) and the planned filing of a Certificate of Amendment with the Delaware Secretary of State around June 11, 2026, with split-adjusted trading expected June 12. There are no M&A or special-situation terms; this is a routine corporate action to maintain listing compliance. No deal terms or advisory roles are applicable; what to watch is exchange compliance.
